rows.text: The Company revised its estimate of adjusted net income per diluted share for the full year of 2026 from a range of $3.73 to $3.93 to a range of $3.83 to $3.93, a 4% increase at the midpoint of the range over adjusted net income per diluted share of $3.72 in 2025.

For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company provided an estimate of adjusted net income per diluted share in the range of $0.76 to $0.86, a 21% increase at the midpoint of the range over adjusted net income per diluted share of $0.67 in the fourth quarter of 2025.
